extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Addition and subtraction of two-digit numbers with and without regrouping — without regrouping: 25 + 13 = 38 (add ones 5+3=8, add tens 2+1=3). With regrouping: 36 + 27 = 63 (ones 6+7=13, write 3 carry 1, tens 3+2+1=6). Subtraction without regrouping: 45 - 23 = 22. Subtraction with regrouping: 52 - 28 = 24 (cannot do 2-8, borrow 1 ten, 12-8=4, 4-2=2). (2) Place value in standard algorithm — always align ones under ones, tens under tens. Carry when ones add up to 10 or more. Borrow when top digit is smaller than bottom digit. (3) Adding/subtracting zero — any number + 0 = the same number. Any number - 0 = the same number. Zero is special — it does not change the number. (4) Commutative property — 34 + 56 = 56 + 34 (order does not matter in addition). BUT subtraction is NOT commutative: 56 - 34 is not the same as 34 - 56. (5) Word problems — read the problem carefully, identify what we need to find, decide if we add or subtract. 'More' or 'total' usually means add. 'Less' or 'left' or 'gave away' usually means subtract. (6) Estimation — round to nearest 10 and then add or subtract. 18 is about 20, 23 is about 20, so 18+23 is about 40. Estimation gives a quick approximate answer. (7) Mental addition/subtraction — break numbers into tens and ones. 25 + 13: 20+10=30, 5+3=8, total 38. Practice doing simple sums in your head. Misconceptions: 'addition and subtraction are the same' (addition combines, subtraction takes away), 'we can subtract in any order' (subtraction is NOT commutative, 56-34 is not 34-56), 'carrying means adding 1 to the answer' (carrying moves 1 ten to the next column, it is not extra), 'estimation must be exact' (estimation is an approximate answer, close to the real answer), 'zero makes the number disappear' (zero does not change the number, 47+0=47 not 0). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AddSubGame), NOT export default. Export interface AddSubGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
